verdict.rationale: GitLab's own materials show merge requests are a core object: agents turn issues into merge requests and review code, and security findings appear directly in merge requests. Community evidence that the GitHub importer brings over pull requests and review comments implies GitLab stores review comments. However, no evidence describes diff comparison or inline, line-level commenting alongside code. Missing for 10: first-party docs on merge request diff views, inline line-level review comments, and hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
